notes.direction_read: Quarter likely beats (easy cyber-impaired comp, 29.9% four-quarter average surprise, 10 up / 0 down 90-day revisions). Direction is decided by the first FY27 guide, delivered by a CFO who started 2026-08-10, against EIA diesel at $5.599/gal (+50% y/y), a pre-announced step-up in technology and supply-chain investment, natural-segment growth halving over three quarters, and SNAP cuts the CEO has already conceded are biting. That asymmetry drives the mild negative tilt. Offsetting it: the stock is already -23.5% from its 52-week high and -10.25% over 21 sessions, short interest is only 4.5% of float, there is effectively no options crowd and no retail crowd, and the two prior quarters that entered with a comparably negative 21-day run-up both printed up days. Close to a coin flip; conviction deliberately Low.
notes.triage_note: The triage hint said this name was carried through without a scored rationale. My independent view: research adds real value here and the name clears any reasonable move-potential bar. Six-quarter mean absolute reaction is 9.7% with a 18.45% max, the event-implied move is ~10.6%, and the print carries a genuine binary (first FY27 guide from a new CFO). The counterargument is liquidity: $2.6bn cap, ~490k shares/day 20-day average volume, and an options chain that traded 62 contracts on 2026-09-01 - so this is not a tradeable options event, only an equity one.
